preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of friends is less than the number of rooms, and the number of rooms is at most 200,000.
Each friend is in a room numbered between 2 and n.
Each corridor connects two rooms numbered between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases is not greater than 2 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of rooms across all test cases is at most 200,000.

postconditions.description: The answer is -1 if Vlad wins anyway, or a number between 1 and k indicating the minimum number of friends that must remain in the maze for them to win.

invariants.description: No two friends are in the same room.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= u_j, v_j <= n for j)
invariants.description: Each corridor connects two rooms within the range of room numbers.
No corridor connects a room to itself.

invariants.expression: all(u_j != x_i and v_j != x_i for i, j)
invariants.description: No corridor or friend's room is in the same room as Vlad.
No corridor connects a room to itself.
